# KQED

> KQED is the San Francisco Bay Area's public television and media organization, providing PBS programming, news coverage, and interactive content for California audiences.

KQED operates as a major public broadcasting station serving the Bay Area and California with live TV streaming, documentaries, news analysis, and community-focused reporting on local issues like Oakland Schools and elections. The organization combines traditional television programming with digital games, quizzes, and interactive features.

## Key Topics

- Public Television
- Bay Area News
- PBS Programs

## Video & TV Streaming

- [KQED TV](https://www.kqed.org/tv): KQED's main TV hub with PBS programming, live streaming, and schedules.
- [KQED Video](https://video.kqed.org): KQED's main video streaming platform featuring PBS shows and documentaries.

## News & Elections Coverage

- [Election 2025](https://www.kqed.org/elections): KQED's 2025 election coverage with voting guides and ballot information.
- [Live Bay Area and California Election 2022 Updates](https://www.kqed.org/liveblog/election-2022): Live election coverage and results from Bay Area and California 2022 elections.
- [Oakland Schools Coverage](https://www.kqed.org/oaklandschools): KQED reporting and analysis on Oakland Schools challenges and opportunities.
- [Wildfire Smoke in the Bay Area](https://www.kqed.org/liveblog/wildfire-smoke-in-the-bay-area): Live updates on wildfire smoke impacts and air quality in Bay Area.
- [Senator Dianne Feinstein Dies at 90](https://www.kqed.org/liveblog/dianne-feinstein-dies): Live coverage and updates on Senator Dianne Feinstein's death and succession.

## Interactive Games & Puzzles

- [Crossword](https://www.kqed.org/crossword): Daily crossword puzzle game with newsletter signup and Bay Area news content.
- [Radio News Quiz](https://www.kqed.org/radionewsquiz): Daily radio news quiz contest for KQED listeners across California.
